audit.why: Favoured lane (4/10) — Xerath outranges Viktor's whole kit early; danger is Gravity Field lock and Viktor's late scaling. Chart Xerath in all 7 rows, both layers agree.
All 4 spikes present: 3-5 range window, 6, first item, late (Viktor outscales). Content and full agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer used two wrong ability names — 'Death Ray' (really Hextech Ray, E) and 'Chaos Storm' (really Arcane Storm, R) — across 11 fields. Missing interactions: Arcane Storm interrupts channels (it cancels your R), your E stun cancels his R channel, his Gravity Field cancels your R channel, and his combo opens with a Siphon Power auto-reset tell.
audit.why: Kit file is authority: E is Hextech Ray, R is Arcane Storm. Xerath R is an interruptible channel; Viktor R both is a channel and interrupts channels per Riot's text.
audit.corrected: All name occurrences corrected; channel interactions written into spikes[1].text; auto-reset tell into spikes[0].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two copy-paste-bleed bullets and a cooldowns field with no digit.

audit.corrected: Both bullets rewritten to match their titles; cooldowns now carries W 17s, Q 9s, E 13s.

edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. It governs your forward steps. - E Shocking Orb spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Viktor W Gravity Field: 17s at rank 1 — the stun zone owns every all-in; walk out the moment it drops, commit only while it is down. - His Q shield cycles every 9s early — poke between casts. - Your E Shocking Orb is 13s; spent on poke it is a death you scheduled.

edits.before: Q the last-hit from beyond his answer range, W the lateral dodge, and walk — a one-way trade he can only end by leaving the lane.
edits.after: Your W's centre lands the stronger slow — after a Q hit his sidestep is predictable, and at a 14s cooldown you get one W per trade window.

edits.before: Spending E on chip and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive on schedule — the stun is your only 'no' and everyone knows it.
edits.after: Overextended, you hand his jungler the Gravity Field setup — one 800-range W under your feet and the 1v2 ends before your E even lands.

edits.after: At level 1 your Q and W outrange his Hextech Ray, so you poke him for free.

edits.before: At 4-5 you poke from outside Death Ray and simply space his Gravity Field, keeping the lane yours.
edits.after: At 4-5 you poke from outside Hextech Ray and simply space his Gravity Field, keeping the lane yours.

edits.before: Your Q Arcanopulse and W outrange his E Death Ray, so poke him every time he steps up to farm or throws the laser. He's immobile like you but shorter-ranged early, so you win the standing exchange — punish him hard before he completes his Hex Core upgrade and starts to even the poke.
edits.after: Your Q Arcanopulse and W outrange his E Hextech Ray, so poke him every time he steps up to farm or throws the laser. His burst opens with a Siphon Power auto-attack reset — the wind-up is your step-back cue. Punish him hard before his Hex Core upgrades start to even the poke.

edits.before: Viktor's R Chaos Storm is strong in extended fights but he still needs W Gravity Field to lock you first, and you outrange the setup. Never stand in the Gravity Field zone; hold E Shocking Orb for his walk-up, and keep W charged to slow him. Your R is better used to zone or answer roams than to duel a shielded Viktor.
edits.after: Viktor's R Arcane Storm interrupts channels — never cast your own R inside its 700 range — but he still needs W Gravity Field to lock you, and you outrange that setup. Never stand in the field; hold E Shocking Orb for his walk-up: your stun also cancels his storm channel the moment he starts it.

edits.before: Viktor scales hard, so your job is to keep the early and mid lead you built with range. Stay outside E Death Ray, never eat a Gravity Field stun, and poke him down before Chaos Storm and his upgrades let a teamfight go long. Ward flanks — a scaled Viktor with jungle help is the real threat, not the 1v1.
edits.after: Viktor scales hard, so your job is to keep the early and mid lead you built with range.
